events.title: NSF NCAR Super Science Saturday 2026 — 30 Years of Boldly Going
events.location: NSF NCAR Mesa Lab, 1850 Table Mesa Drive, Boulder, CO 80305
events.cost: Free public science festival admission; family of five $0
events.age: Public event for all ages, adults and children welcome; special event registration requirement not stated on organizer page
events.description: One-day annual large-scale NSF/UCAR public science celebration with hands-on exploration of Earth-system science and public science activities, hosted at a working atmospheric research campus (not just a regular free visitor-center visit). The 2026 theme is the 30th anniversary, '30 Years of Boldly Going'. Organizer confirms Saturday Nov 7 2026 10:00-16:00, free and public for all ages. 2026 local residents/friends; before June 2027 visiting family arrival. Venue/address confirmed on official UCAR visitor page.

events.title: Monumental Impact 2026 MITEE Gobble Squabble — free Robot Chaos and Makers Expo
events.time: 10:00 AM–5:00 PM MST; robot combat from 10:00, Makers & Community Expo 10:30–14:30, FTC scrimmage 11:00–15:00, Open Robotics 15:30–17:00 (subject to organizer changes)
events.location: Bear Creek Elementary School, 1330 Creekside Dr, Monument, CO 80132
events.cost: Free for public spectators and makers expo, explicitly confirmed by organizer; family of five $0; participating as a competitor may have separate costs
events.age: Public family event, guests and children welcome, watching competition or visiting expo requires no membership; competing teams have separate registration
events.description: One-day 6th annual rare combined robot combat arena, student FTC scrimmage, open robotics contest, and Makers & Community Expo. Official organizer explicitly states no charge for viewing robotics competitions or visiting expo; visitors can meet robot builders and watch several distinct technical competitions. High experience value despite distance from Denver metro. Event is in 2026 for current local residents/friends, not the family's 2027-28 stay.
